Q: How to use fcntl when only a file desciptors is available? A:

You can also also use IO::Handle::new_from_fd:


perl -MFcntl -MIO::Handle -e 'printf "%x\n", IO::Handle->new_from_fd(1, "r")->fcntl(F_GETFL, 0)'

Q: Syntax for Insert Formula with Less than/Greater Than Operators A:

When there are multiple concatenations it's easy to get mixed up, so a token-replacement approach is typically easier to deal with.

Example:

Sub FindPreviousDate()

    Const MAXIFS_FRM As String = _
       "=MAXIFS(${refDtCol}$2:${refDtCol}${lr},${recIdCol}$2:${recIdCol}${lr}," & _
       "${recIdCol}2,${refDtCol}$2:${refDtCol}${lr},""<"" & {refDtCol}2)"
    
    Dim wksPrevious As Worksheet, HeaderRange As Range, lastrow As Long
    Dim RecordIDColumn As String, ReferralDateColumn As String
    
    Set wksPrevious = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("PreviousDate")
    Set HeaderRange = wksPrevious.Range("A1:F1") 'my test range...
    lastrow = wksPrevious.Cells(Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
    'Find any required headers
    RecordIDColumn = HeaderColumn(HeaderRange, "Client ID [SP/CORE]")
    ReferralDateColumn = HeaderColumn(HeaderRange, "Related Timeline Event: Referral date")
    If Len(RecordIDColumn) = 0 Or Len(ReferralDateColumn) = 0 Then Exit Sub
            
    wksPrevious.Range("K1") = "Previous Referral Date"
    wksPrevious.Range("K2").Formula = DoSubs(MAXIFS_FRM, _
                                             "{lr}", lastrow, _
                                             "{refDtCol}", ReferralDateColumn, _
                                             "{recIdCol}", RecordIDColumn)

End Sub

'Replace tokens in `txt`, using pairs of token+value passed to `subs`
Function DoSubs(ByVal txt As String, ParamArray subs() As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, res As String
    For i = 0 To UBound(subs) Step 2
        txt = Replace(txt, subs(i), subs(i + 1))
    Next i
    DoSubs = txt
End Function

'Return the column letter for header `hdr` matched in range `HeaderRange`
Function HeaderColumn(HeaderRange As Range, hdr As String) As String
    Dim f As Range
    Set f = HeaderRange.Find(hdr)
    If Not f Is Nothing Then
        HeaderColumn = Replace(f.EntireColumn.Cells(1).Address(False, False), "1", "")
    Else
        MsgBox "Header '" & hdr & "' not found in range " & HeaderRange.Address
    End If
End Function

A good use for ParamArray: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/language/concepts/getting-started/understanding-parameter-arrays
